title: One-time hints show once per account, across browsers and devices
steps: Run the onboarding package tests and the voice tip account test on this branch.
Render the site tour and the voice tip in a fresh browser for an account the server reports as having seen them.
Render them for an account that has not seen them, finish them, and check the account record is written; carry over an existing browser mark.
Read the desktop first-run state for an account that completed onboarding on another device.
expect: A fresh browser does not show the site tour or the voice tip when the account has seen them.
Finishing a hint records it on the account; an old browser mark is recorded on the account once and removed.
A failed read does not show the hint.
The desktop app does not reopen the first-run tour for an account that completed it.

tests: a previously seen account does not see the tip on a fresh browser
legacy browser state is copied to the account then removed
account seen hints suppress the site tour in a fresh browser
a failed seen-hint read hides the site tour
desktop stage 1 through the surface overlay uses account completion on a new device
the desktop surface: the account decides both flags
